_about: Benjamin Whichcote (1609-1683), provost of King's College, Cambridge, and father of the Cambridge Platonists. Raw IA OCR: The Works of the Learned Benjamin Whichcote (Aberdeen: J. Chalmers for Alexander Thomson, MDCCLI), vol. I (clean 0.87), vol. III (clean 0.78; the OCR garbles the year as MDCCI) and vol. IV (clean 0.86; year read MDCCLL). Held: vol. II, whose scan shows no legible year; the 1742 Select Sermons and 1703 Moral and Religious Aphorisms (ECCO OCR below 0.78). Also here: The Cambridge Platonists, being selections from the writings of Benjamin Whichcote, John Smith and Nathanael Culverwel, with introduction by E. T. Campagnac (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1901), clean 0.93. US public domain. No uids minted.
